reconcile.note: Gill treats the trial testimony as a garbled echo of Jesus' own temple saying in John 2:19, not an invented charge, since the witnesses misquoted his wording.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Karl Gottlieb Bretschneider argued that since Matthew and Mark call the trial witnesses false, Jesus never actually spoke John's temple-and-body saying at all.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Karl Gottlieb Bretschneider (1820), Probabilia de Evangelii et Epistolarum Joannis Apostoli indole et origine.

sides.snippet: This man said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.'
sides.verseText: and said, \"This man said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.'\"

sides.snippet: Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
sides.verseText: Jesus answered them, \"Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.\"
